mapper.select:
SELECT a.QUESTION_ID_1, c.QUESTION_DSCR AS QUESTION_DSCR_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2, h.QUESTION_DSCR AS QUESTION_DSCR_2, a.QUESTION_ID, d.QUESTION_DSCR, a.QUESTION_CONTENT, d.QUESTION_OPINIONS, e.RULE_FILE_NAME, e.RULE_FILE_NO, e.RULE_FILE_CONTENT, l.ID as REFORM_ID, f.REFORM_SCHEME, f.MEMO, g.INSPECTION_TASK_ID, g.INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` d ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = d.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` c ON a.QUESTION_ID_1 = c.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` h ON a.QUESTION_ID_2 = h.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.inspection_reform_ledger l ON a.LEDGER_ID = l.LEDGER_ID JOIN inspection.inspection_reform_scheme f ON l.ID = f.REFORM_ID JOIN inspection.inspection_task g ON a.TASK_ID = g.INSPECTION_TASK_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t1.RULE_FILE_NAME, t1.RULE_FILE_NO, t1.RULE_FILE_CONTENT, t2.`QUESTION_ID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_rule` t1 JOIN inspection.`inspection_question_rule_relation` t2 ON t1.RULE_ID = t2.`RULE_ID` WHERE t1.RULE_STATE = '0' ) e ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = e.QUESTION_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND l.ID = #{params.ID}
